Before draping oneself in the טלית the following is said:
Then this ברכה is recited while standing:
One then drapes oneself in the טלית and says:
One then removes the טלית from the face and drapes oneself in such a way that there should be one ציצת in front and one behind on each side.
תְּפִלּוֹת.
Prayers
On entering the Synagogue:
On entering the Synagogue:
Before the morning prayer:
Before the morning prayer:
תְּפִלַּת שַׁחֲרִית.
Morning Prayer
In place of the preceding benediction women say:
In place of the preceding benediction women say:
לְעוֹלָם יְהֵא אָדָם יְרֵא שָׁמַֽיִם בְּסֵֽתֶר וּמוֹדֶה עַל־הָאֱמֶת וְדוֹבֵר אֱמֶת בִּלְבָבוֹ וְיַשְׁכֵּם וְיֹאמַר:
Let man always fear God in private, acknowledge the truth, speak truth in his heart and rise early in the morning and say:
אַם שַׁבָּת ווירד פֿאָלגענדעז איינגעסאַלטעט:
